features.title: Notification outbox dispatch recovery and deterministic evaluation
acceptance_criteria: Claimed notifications are processed in a bounded batch using row locks and SKIP LOCKED
Successful sends persist provider message IDs and clear prior errors
Retryable failures use bounded exponential backoff
Permanent failures and exhausted attempts move to failed
One failed notification does not prevent later batch items from being processed
features.notes: Injectable sender seam and regression tests added; GitHub Actions verification pending.
